docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This script uses the pyvisa library to communicate with external hardware over VISA protocol (e.g., GPIB, USB, RS232). It’s used to query device identity and test connectivity.

docs.title: setupDAQ.py
docs.text:
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i># setupDAQ.py</i></span>
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i># This script sets up a Data Acquisition 
(DAQ) task using NI-DAQmx in Python.</i></span>
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i># It defines which channels to use, the 
timing of the acquisition,</i></span>
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i># and how the DAQ system starts and 
stops.</i></span>

This script sets up a Data Acquisition (DAQ) task using NI-DAQmx in Python. It defines which channels to use, the timing of the acquisition, and how the DAQ system starts and stops.

docs.title: Setup
docs.text:
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i>import nidaqmx</i></span>

Import the NI-DAQmx Python library.

<span style="color:#1565c0"><i>task = nidaqmx.Task()</i></span>

Create a new task object to manage DAQ operations.

docs.title: Channel Configuration
docs.text:
<span 
style="color:#1565c0"><i>task.ai_channels.add_ai_voltage_chan("Dev1/ai0", 
min_val=-10.0, max_val=10.0)</i></span>

Add AI0 channel on Dev1 with ±10V input range.

docs.title: Clock and Sampling Rate
docs.text:
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i>task.timing.cfg_samp_clk_timing(</i></span>
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i>    rate=1000,</i></span>
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i>    
sample_mode=nidaqmx.constants.AcquisitionType.CONTINUOUS</i></span>
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i>)</i></span>

Configure the sample clock for continuous acquisition at 1000 Hz.

docs.title: Task Execution
docs.text:
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i>task.start()</i></span>

Start the task to begin acquisition.

<span style="color:#1565c0"><i># Insert acquisition logic here (e.g., read 
buffer, log data)</i></span>

Placeholder for your acquisition or processing logic.

<span style="color:#1565c0"><i>task.stop()</i></span>

Stop the task after acquisition is complete.

<span style="color:#1565c0"><i>task.close()</i></span>

Close the task to release hardware and clean up resources.

docs.title: Output Summary
docs.text:
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i># AI0 on Dev1 configured for 
±10V</i></span>
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i># Sampling at 1000 Hz, continuous 
mode</i></span>
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i># System is ready for integration in a DAQ 
loop</i></span>

System is now fully initialized and ready for real-time data acquisition.

docs.title: Why Use This Script?
docs.text:
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i># Quick DAQ hardware setup</i></span>
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i># Avoids boilerplate duplication</i></span>
<span style="color:#1565c0"><i># Separates setup logic from runtime 
processing</i></span>

Useful for lab automation, reusable scripts, and scalable data systems.
